summary: The open AI model ecosystem spans model repositories, where developers share and download open-weight models, and developer-facing inference platforms that serve those models via APIs. Hugging Face dominates as the central hub, crossing 3 million public models in August 2026, though downloads remain highly concentrated — roughly half of all models have fewer than 200 downloads while the top 200 models account for nearly half of all downloads. A parallel layer of inference providers (Together AI, Fireworks AI, Replicate, SiliconFlow, Ollama, and others) has emerged to make these open models easy to run locally or at scale without managing infrastructure, increasingly dominated by high-parameter Chinese open models.

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.purpose: The central open repository and community hub for AI models, datasets, and demos (Spaces), with hosted Inference Endpoints and serverless inference. Acts as the de facto distribution layer for open-weight models.
platforms.model_count: ~3 million public models (crossed 3M in August 2026, adding ~747,000 in the first 7.7 months of 2026)
platforms.pricing: Free tier for public hosting and limited serverless inference; PRO at ~$9/month; Inference Endpoints billed per-hour by compute (GPU/CPU); Enterprise plans custom-priced
features: Largest model, dataset, and Spaces catalog
Serverless Inference API and dedicated Inference Endpoints
Download-stat tracking via query files to avoid double counting
Git-based model versioning and model cards
platforms.best_for: Developers and researchers who want the broadest selection of open models, community collaboration, and flexible hosting from experimentation to production

platforms.name: Ollama
platforms.purpose: A lightweight tool for running open LLMs locally on personal machines and servers, packaging models with a simple CLI and local REST API.
platforms.model_count: ~200+ curated models in its library (plus the ability to import GGUF models from Hugging Face)
platforms.pricing: Free and open source; runs on local hardware so costs are only your own compute
features: One-command local model download and run
Optimized GGUF quantized models for consumer hardware
Modelfile customization and private local inference
Growing cloud option for larger models
platforms.best_for: Developers and privacy-conscious users who want to run open models locally for prototyping, offline use, or on-device applications

platforms.name: Replicate
platforms.purpose: A cloud platform for running and deploying open-source models via API, including packaging custom models as containers (Cog) that scale automatically.
platforms.model_count: Thousands of community-published models across text, image, video, and audio
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-use billed by compute time (per-second GPU/CPU usage); no subscription required
features: Run models with a single API call
Cog framework for packaging and publishing custom models
Strong support for image/video/audio generation models
platforms.best_for: Developers who want to deploy, share, or call generative models (especially multimodal) via API without managing GPU infrastructure

platforms.name: Together AI
platforms.purpose: A high-performance inference and fine-tuning cloud for open models, offering serverless APIs and dedicated GPU clusters for training and large-scale deployment.
platforms.model_count: 200+ open models (LLMs, code, image, and embedding models)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token for inference (varies by model size); per-hour dedicated GPU instances; custom training pricing
features: Supports large frontier open models (DeepSeek, Llama, Qwen, etc.)
platforms.best_for: Startups and enterprises needing scalable, performant inference and fine-tuning for open LLMs with OpenAI-compatible APIs

platforms.name: Fireworks AI
platforms.purpose: A production-focused inference platform optimized for ultra-fast, cost-efficient serving of open LLMs and multimodal models, with fine-tuning and compound AI features.
platforms.model_count: 100+ curated open models plus custom model hosting
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token for serverless inference; per-GPU-hour for dedicated deployments; fine-tuning priced per token
features: LoRA fine-tuning and custom model uploads
Function calling and structured output (JSON mode)
Support for large reasoning and vision models
platforms.best_for: Production teams prioritizing low latency, high throughput, and cost efficiency when serving open LLMs at scale

platforms.name: SiliconFlow
platforms.purpose: An inference platform (strong in the Chinese and Asian markets) offering fast, affordable API access to a wide range of open LLMs, image, and audio models.
platforms.model_count: 100+ open models, with strong coverage of Chinese open models (Qwen, DeepSeek, GLM, MiniMax, Moonshot/Kimi, etc.)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token pricing, often highly competitive; free credits/tiers for select models
features: Broad catalog of leading Chinese open models
Text, image, audio, and video generation models
platforms.best_for: Developers wanting cost-effective access to top Chinese open models and multimodal inference, particularly in Asian markets

platforms.name: Groq
platforms.purpose: An inference platform built on custom LPU (Language Processing Unit) hardware delivering exceptionally high token-generation speed for open LLMs.
platforms.model_count: Dozens of supported open models (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mixtral, Gemma, Whisper, etc.)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token, with pricing tied to model size; generous developer free tier
features: Support for speech-to-text (Whisper) and reasoning models
platforms.best_for: Developers building latency-sensitive, real-time applications (chat, agents, voice) needing the fastest open-model inference

platforms.name: OpenRouter
platforms.purpose: A unified API gateway that routes requests across many model providers (both open and proprietary) through a single OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
platforms.model_count: 300+ models aggregated across dozens of providers
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token passthrough pricing with provider-based rates; some free models; small routing margin
features: Single API for many providers and models
Automatic fallback and provider routing by price/latency
Access to both open and closed models
platforms.best_for: Developers who want provider-agnostic access to many models with easy switching and unified billing

platforms.name: DeepInfra
platforms.purpose: A low-cost serverless inference platform for running open-source LLMs, embeddings, and multimodal models via simple API calls.
platforms.model_count: 100+ open models across text, image, and audio
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token (very competitive); per-hour dedicated GPU options
platforms.best_for: Cost-sensitive developers seeking cheap, simple API access to popular open models
